searchDocs.title: Init​
searchDocs.content: </> DataVault:Init(Options: Config<T>) → table-- Server & Client instances Opens a DataVault instance for the current environment. On the server this returns a server object (Open → session + state API). On the client this returns a client replica object. Type solver required Typed State<T> / Access<T> requires the new Luau type solver. See the class docs for how to enable it.

searchDocs.title: Open​
searchDocs.content: </> DataVaultClient.Open(Options: Types.Config<T>) → DataVaultClient Opens (or returns) the client replica for Options.StoreName. :::danger Type solver requiredTyped State requires the new Luau type solver. Annotate after load: local S: DataVault.State<MyData> = Client:Explicit() :::

searchDocs.title: Explicit​
searchDocs.content: </> DataVaultClient:Explicit() → State<T> Typed state tree for the local replica. Type solver required Annotate: local S: DataVault.State<MyData> = Client:Explicit()

searchDocs.title: State
searchDocs.content: State Typed state node for one path under a session. Obtained from DataVaultServer:State / :Player or DataVaultClient:State. :::danger Type solver requiredThe new Luau type solver is required for typed State<T> / Access<T>. Enable Workspace.UseNewLuauTypeSolver = Enabled, then annotate: local S: DataVault.State<MyData> = Server:State(key) S.Coins.Get() S.Coins.Increment(50) S.Inventory.OnInsert(function(id, item) end) Without the new solver, methods still run, but autocomplete will not expand fields or type-specific methods from your template. ::: All nodes: Get, Set, Update, Observe, Raw, Snapshot, call sugar Numbers: Increment, Decrement, Clamp Tables: Has, Keys, Values, Size, Clear, Insert, Remove, OnInsert, OnRemove Arrays: Push, Pop, InsertAt, RemoveAt, Length Root: Mutate, Save, End, Replicate

searchDocs.title: Required​
searchDocs.content: Option	Type	DescriptionStoreName	string	Name of the underlying DataStore. Template	T	Your player data shape. Used as the template for newly created profiles.

searchDocs.title: Storage & Keys​
searchDocs.content: Option	Type	Default	DescriptionKeyPrefix	string	""	Prefix added to every profile key. PlayerKey	(Player) -> string	—	Custom function used to generate a player's profile key. Mock	boolean	false	Uses ProfileStore's mock store. Useful for Studio testing.

searchDocs.title: Player Lifecycle​
searchDocs.content: Option	Type	Default	DescriptionBindPlayers	boolean	false	Automatically load and manage profiles when players join and leave. KickOnFail	boolean	false	Kick the player when their profile fails to load. KickOnSessionEnd	boolean	false	Kick the player when their active profile session ends unexpectedly. KickMessage	string	—	Message displayed when a player is kicked because of a data failure or session ending. LoadTimeout	number	—	Maximum amount of time, in seconds, to wait for a profile to load.

searchDocs.title: Schema & Migrations​
searchDocs.content: Option	Type	Default	DescriptionSchemaVersion	number	—	Current schema version of your player data. Migrate	(Data: T, FromVersion: number, ToVersion: number) -> ()	—	Called when data needs to be migrated between schema versions.

searchDocs.title: Saving​
searchDocs.content: Option	Type	Default	DescriptionAutoSaveSeconds	number	—	Custom interval, in seconds, between automatic saves. FlushImmediately	boolean	—	Immediately flushes pending changes instead of waiting for the normal save cycle. ReplicateOnSave	boolean	—	Replicates the latest data when a save occurs.

searchDocs.title: Replication​
searchDocs.content: Option	Type	Default	DescriptionReplicateMode	"Diff" | "Full" | "Hybrid"	—	Controls how server data is replicated to clients. MaxPatchesBeforeFull	number	24	Forces a full snapshot after this many pending patches. CollapsePatchesAt	number	12	Collapses accumulated patches once this threshold is reached. ClientGuard	"Proxy" | "Off"	"Proxy"	Controls whether replicated client data is protected by a read-only proxy.  Replication Modes​  Mode	Description"Diff"	Replicates individual changes as patches. "Full"	Replicates the complete data snapshot. "Hybrid"	Uses patches normally and falls back to full snapshots when appropriate.

searchDocs.title: Mutation Hooks​
searchDocs.content: Option	Type	DescriptionBeforeMutate	(Context: MutateContext<T>) -> ()	Called immediately before a mutation is applied. AfterMutate	(Context: MutateContext<T>) -> ()	Called immediately after a mutation is applied.  The mutation context contains:  { Key = string, Player = Player?, Data = T, }

searchDocs.title: From DevForum / Releases​
searchDocs.content: Download the latest .rbxm from the DevForum post or GitHub Releases.Place the DataVault folder into ReplicatedStorage (or any shared location).Enable API Services in your game settings (Game Settings → Security → Enable Studio Access to API Services).

searchDocs.title: Wally​
searchDocs.content: [dependencies] DataVault = "soggybird0/datavault@0.1.0"

searchDocs.title: Folder Structure​
searchDocs.content: After installing you should see something like:  ReplicatedStorage └── DataVault.luau ├── Types.luau ├── Server.luau ├── Client.luau ├── Util.luau └── Libraries ├── ProfileStore.luau ├── Signal.luau └── Remote.luau   info DataVault includes its own copy of ProfileStore, Signal, and Remote for convenience. You do not need to install ProfileStore separately unless you want to use it elsewhere.

searchDocs.title: Why DataVault?​
searchDocs.content: Feature	BenefitFully typed	Autocomplete + type safety for your entire data shape Automatic replication	Clients stay in sync with minimal network traffic Session signals	Easy OnJoin, Changed, load/end events ProfileStore under the hood	Session locking, auto-save, and battle-tested reliability

searchDocs.content: InstallationGetting StartedConfigurationAPI Reference

searchDocs.title: 1. Create a Shared Module​
searchDocs.content: Create a ModuleScript (e.g. SharedVault) that both server and client can require:  -- SharedVault.luau local DataVault = require(path.to.DataVault) return DataVault:Init({ StoreName = "PlayerData_v1", Template = { Coins = 0, Level = 1, Inventory = {}, -- your full data shape here }, -- Optional (see Configuration page) -- KeyPrefix = "Player_", -- UseMock = true, -- KickOnFail = true, -- AutoSaveSeconds = 30, })

searchDocs.title: 2. Server Usage​
searchDocs.content: -- Server.luau local SharedVault = require(path.to.SharedVault) local Vault = SharedVault.Server Vault:OnPlayerJoin(function(session) print(session.Data.Coins) -- Simple set session:Set("Coins", session.Data.Coins + 100) -- Path-based set session:Set({"Inventory", "Sword"}, true) -- Full mutate session:Mutate(function(data) data.Level += 1 return data end) end)

searchDocs.title: 3. Client Usage​
searchDocs.content: -- Client.luau local SharedVault = require(path.to.SharedVault) local Vault = SharedVault.Client -- Get the current session (or wait for it) local session = Vault:Get() -- non-yielding -- or local session = Vault:Wait() -- yields until ready print(session.Data.Coins) session.Changed:Connect(function(path, value) print(`Changed: {path}, {value}`) end)   caution Client data is read-only. All mutations must happen on the server.

searchDocs.title: Open​
searchDocs.content: </> DataVaultServer.Open(Options: Types.Config<T>) → DataVaultServer Opens a server DataVault bound to Options.StoreName. Type solver required Typed access via :Explicit / :Player requires the new Luau type solver.

searchDocs.title: KeyFor​
searchDocs.content: </> DataVaultServer:KeyFor(Player: Player ) → string Builds the session key for a player (KeyPrefix + UserId by default).

searchDocs.title: Explicit​
searchDocs.content: </> DataVaultServer:Explicit(Key: string) → State<T> Returns the typed state tree for a session key. :::danger Type solver requiredAnnotate the result for autocomplete: local S: DataVault.State<MyData> = Server:Explicit(key) The new Luau type solver must be enabled or fields will not expand. :::

searchDocs.title: Load​
searchDocs.content: </> DataVaultServer:Load( Key: string, Params: Types.SessionParams? ) → Profile<T>? Starts (or returns) an active ProfileStore session for Key.

searchDocs.title: End​
searchDocs.content: </> DataVaultServer:End(Key: string) → () Ends the session for Key and clears pending replication.

searchDocs.title: BindPlayers​
searchDocs.content: </> DataVaultServer:BindPlayers() → () Binds Players.PlayerAdded / PlayerRemoving to Load/End using KeyFor.

searchDocs.title: Get​
searchDocs.content: </> DataVaultServer:Get(Key: string) → T? Returns live profile data for an active session, or nil.

searchDocs.title: IsLoaded​
searchDocs.content: </> DataVaultServer:IsLoaded(Key: string) → boolean Whether an active session exists for Key.

searchDocs.title: Wait​
searchDocs.content: </> DataVaultServer:Wait( Key: string, Timeout: number? ) → Profile<T>? Yields until the session for Key is loaded (or timeout).

searchDocs.title: WaitData​
searchDocs.content: </> DataVaultServer:WaitData( Key: string, Timeout: number? ) → ( T?, LoadFailureReason? ) Yields for data only. Returns (nil, reason) on failure.

searchDocs.title: Keys​
searchDocs.content: </> DataVaultServer:Keys() → {string} Active session keys.

searchDocs.title: Save​
searchDocs.content: </> DataVaultServer:Save(Key: string) → () Saves one active session.

searchDocs.title: SaveAll​
searchDocs.content: </> DataVaultServer:SaveAll() → () Saves every active session.

searchDocs.title: Replicate​
searchDocs.content: </> DataVaultServer:Replicate( Key: string, Target: Player? ) → () Forces a full buffer replica for Key (optionally to one player).

searchDocs.title: Flush​
searchDocs.content: </> DataVaultServer:Flush(Key: string?) → () Flushes pending patches/full replicas now.

searchDocs.title: Message​
searchDocs.content: </> DataVaultServer:Message( Key: string, Message: Types.JSONAcceptable ) → boolean Sends a ProfileStore cross-server message for Key.

searchDocs.title: View​
searchDocs.content: </> DataVaultServer:View( Key: string, Version: string? ) → Profile<T>? Reads a profile without taking a session lock (view-only).

searchDocs.title: Remove​
searchDocs.content: </> DataVaultServer:Remove(Key: string) → boolean Removes stored data and ends any local session for Key.

searchDocs.title: Destroy​
searchDocs.content: </> DataVaultServer:Destroy() → () Flushes, ends all sessions, and tears down internal state.
